a.side: lane genres on origin/main, before P55

pick: pure-rand xoroshiro128plus(55006): uniformInt without replacement per genre in turn (catch) over P54C dev targets

pairs.text: catch the falling apples but dodge the rotten ones
pairs.why: Game B has more falling coins and dark hazards at once, with threats nearer the player and crowded action in the later scenes. Game A stays comparatively sparse, with longer empty stretches and little visible buildup.

pairs.text: a penguin catches fish raining from the sky on an iceberg
pairs.why: Game B has denser waves of yellow pickups and black bombs, with threats approaching the robot and renewed clusters late in play. Game A stays sparse, with long gaps between isolated objects and little visible buildup.

pairs.text: catch falling stars with a bucket before they hit the ground
pairs.why: Game A builds to a busier finish, with multiple bombs, ringed stars, and yellow pickups at different heights, including bombs close to the player. Game B has similar early action but becomes sparse near the end, with only a lone nearby bomb visible in the final scene.
